CustomField.description: The single Branch Opportunity this Advisor Group is kept in sync with. Set by the New Branch Opportunity flow; admin-editable only. While this Opportunity is open, field edits mirror both ways between the two records; once it closes, the link stays but the sync freezes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Branch Opportunity this Branch mirrors while the deal is open. Set automatically when a Branch Opportunity is created; only administrators can change it.
CustomField.label: Primary Branch Opportunity
